title: OXYGEN Clay Migration
description: Move a Clay workspace into OXYGEN through browser sign-in: discover accessible resources, transfer data, rebuild native Tables, Records and Workflows, and verify coverage. Also handles a user-supplied Clay export.

migrate-from-clay.title: Migrate from Clay
migrate-from-clay.label: Migrate from Clay
migrate-from-clay.summary: Bring your Clay workspace into Oxygen with your Oxygent.
migrate-from-clay.prompt: Move everything accessible in my Clay workspace into Oxygen. Connect Clay in my browser, preserve my data, rebuild supported behavior as native Oxygen objects and explain anything that needs a decision. Keep paid runs, schedules and sends inactive.
trigger_phrases: Move my whole Clay workspace into Oxygen
Clay is too expensive — what's the switch cost?
Import a Clay CSV and re-enrich it
How do I replace Claygent with Oxygen?
Bring my Clay company list over and score it

pilot.check: Verify imported counts and representative original values first; only run a separately approved paid pilot after showing its current preview and ceiling.

migrate-from-clay.business_case: An Oxygent inventories the accessible Clay workspace, transfers existing data and reconstructs supported behavior through native Oxygen tools. Missing source access or incompatible behavior stays visible rather than becoming a silent CSV-only copy.
migrate-from-clay.outcome: Native Oxygen objects with preserved Clay outputs and source configuration, verified transfer counts, source-to-destination links and a reconciliation report covering unsupported, partial and undecided resources.
migrate-from-clay.leading_metric: Discovered resources reconciled and source/export/destination row counts verified
migrate-from-clay.benchmark: 2026-10-04 audit: import 0 credits; a Claygent-style fit grade quoted at 0.075 credits a row; company details 4 a row for description and founded year, 6 for headcount and HQ country, 10 for all; work email measured about 3.3 a row on rows with a LinkedIn URL. A credit is about 1 cent on a plan. Clay's calculator prices data points, not rows.

effort.time_to_value: depends on source size, access and reconstruction choices

credits.pilot: Transfer: 0 data credits; optional paid pilot needs a current quote and cap
credits.full: Oxygent conversation billing applies; future column execution is separately previewed and approved

prerequisites.detail: Clay workspace access with permission for the hosted browser sign-in. A user-supplied CSV is an explicit limited fallback.
